findings.message: When passing strip_tags() the $allowed_tags parameter as an array, the tags should not be enclosed in <> brackets. Found: '<postname>' (tags written with <> brackets in the strip_tags() array form are an existing bug on every PHP version since 7.4, not a deprecation, so the upgrade changes nothing)
